The name Husniya carries the meaning “Good, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Husniya usually hope their child will grow to embody good, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
